instruction.text: Tippe auf das Fragewort im Fragesatz.

atoms.b: Sven asked, “((Where)) is the nearest book shop?”
atoms.sound: Sven asked, “Where is the nearest book shop?”

atoms.b: Sven asked ((where)) the nearest book shop was.
atoms.sound: Sven asked where the nearest book shop was.

atoms.b: Wenn eine Frage in der direkten Rede ein ((++Fragewort Pronomen)) enthält, wird es in der indirekten Rede ((++übernommen verändert)).
atoms.sound: Wenn eine Frage in der direkten Rede ein Fragewort enthält, wird es in der indirekten Rede übernommen.

example.a:
Maya asked her dad, “Have you seen my missing phone anywhere?”

Maya asked her dad if he had seen her missing phone anywhere.
example.sound: Maya asked her dad, “Have you seen my missing phone anywhere?” Maya asked her dad if he had seen her missing phone anywhere.

example.a:
My friend asked me, “Have you heard the latest news about my favourite football player?”

My friend asked me whether I had heard the latest news about her favourite football player.
example.sound: My friend asked me, “Have you heard the latest news about my favourite football player?” My friend asked me whether I had heard the latest news about her favourite football player.

hint.text: Entscheidungsfragen sind Fragen, auf die man mit „Ja“ oder mit „Nein“ antworten kann.

atoms.b: Man verwendet if oder whether in der indirekten Rede, wenn man eine ((++Entscheidungsfrage offene_Frage)) wiedergibt.
atoms.sound: Man verwendet  <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>if</voice> oder  <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>whether</voice> in der indirekten Rede, wenn man eine Entscheidungsfrage wiedergibt.

instruction.text: Vervollständige den Satz in der indirekten Rede, indem du das richtige Wort in die Lücke schreibst.

atoms.a: The teacher asked us, “Have you understood the new topic?”
atoms.b: The teacher asked us ((if whether)) we had understood the new topic.

atoms.a: My friend asked me, “Do you have any plans for the weekend?”
atoms.b: My friend asked me ((if whether)) I had any plans for the weekend.
Mei asked me ((what)) time it was.

atoms.a: Taner asked, “Which team won the basketball match?”
atoms.b: Taner asked ((which)) team had won the basketball match.

example.a:
Harper asked, “Where is the best bakery in town?”

Harper asked where the best bakery in town was.
example.sound: Harper asked, “Where is the best bakery in town?” Harper asked where the best bakery in town was.

atoms.b: In indirekten Fragesätzen befindet sich das ((++Subjekt Prädikat)) vor dem Prädikat. Somit ist die Satzstellung in indirekten Fragen wie bei ((direkten_Fragen ++Aussagesätzen)).
atoms.sound: In indirekten Fragesätzen befindet sich das Subjekt vor dem Prädikat. Somit ist die Satzstellung in indirekten Fragen wie bei Aussagesätzen.

instruction.text: Bilde die Frage in der indirekten Rede. Beachte dabei, dass einige Wörter übrig bleiben können.

atoms.a: Nazli asked, “Have you watched the latest music video of your favourite singer?”
Elijah asked, “Have you finished writing the essay for our English class?”
My friend asked me, “Where have you eaten gnocchi yesterday?”
Daniel asked me, “How much money have you saved for concert tickets?”
